description: Inferred (all-source, Alex 2026-11-24) from WIKIPEDIA-SCREENPLAY, Wikipedia revision 1387360335 (wikitext sha256 5d8e6ccbf4dcb9c2d391ff0165b19fa817da1cde6e1a4e5d3ea522d2161a3f16): section Format and style, the components of a screenplay page. slug line: occurs at the start of each scene and typically contains three pieces of information: whether the scene is set inside or outside (INT. or EXT.; interior or exterior), the specific location, and the time of day. action: is written in the present tense and is limited to what can be heard or seen by the audience. dialogue: the words the characters speak, and is written in a center column.
title: Screenplay element
